name: ltcai
description: Lattice AI — local-first Digital Brain that keeps your knowledge durable across any AI model.

scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build:python
scripts.frontend:openapi: node scripts/run_python.mjs scripts/export_openapi.py frontend/openapi.json && npx openapi-typescript frontend/openapi.json -o frontend/src/api/openapi.ts
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:visual && npm run lint:frontend && npm run frontend:openapi:check && node scripts/check_i18n_literals.mjs && npm run check:i18n-namespaces && npm run check:bundle && npm run check:legacy-debt && npm run check:server-i18n && npm run test:browser-extension && npm run test:vscode-extension && node scripts/check_release_evidence_bound.mjs && npm run check:max-file-lines
scripts.lint:visual: for f in tests/visual/*.js tests/visual/*.cjs tests/visual/mock_server/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'visual syntax ok'
scripts.lint:python: node scripts/run_python.mjs -m ruff check . && npm run typecheck:python
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && cd vscode-extension && npm run build
scripts.test:browser-extension: node --check browser-extension/popup.js && node --check browser-extension/capture-page.js && node --test tests/browser-extension.test.cjs
scripts.rust:lint: cd rust && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.release:evidence: node scripts/capture_release_evidence.mjs && node scripts/prune_release_evidence.mjs && npm run check:screenshot-delta
scripts.release:artifacts: node scripts/clean_release_artifacts.mjs $npm_package_version && npm run build:assets && npm run build:python && npm pack && npm run package:vsix && npm run desktop:tauri:build
scripts.publish:npm: npm pack && npm publish ltcai-$npm_package_version.tgz --access public
scripts.publish:pypi: npm run build:python && node scripts/run_python.mjs -m twine upload --skip-existing dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version.tar.gz dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version-py3-none-any.whl
scripts.publish:vscode: cd vscode-extension && npm run package:vsix && npm run publish:vscode
scripts.publish:openvsx: cd vscode-extension && npm run package:vsix && npm run publish:openvsx
scripts.publish:all: npm run release:artifacts && npm run release:validate && npm publish ltcai-$npm_package_version.tgz --access public && node scripts/run_python.mjs -m twine upload --skip-existing dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version.tar.gz dist/ltcai-$npm_package_version-py3-none-any.whl && cd vscode-extension && npm run publish:vscode && npm run publish:openvsx
scripts.test:vscode-extension: cd vscode-extension && npm run build && cd .. && node --test tests/vscode-extension.test.cjs
